instruction.name: vsle.d
instruction.description: Compare the signed 64-bit elements in `a` and `b`, store all-ones to `dst` if corresponding element in `a` is less than or equal to `b`, zero otherwise.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vsle.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vsle.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vsle.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vsle.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vsle.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vsle.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vsle.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vsle.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr16, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr17, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr18, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr19, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr20, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr21, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr22, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr23, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr16, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr17, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr18, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr19, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr20, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr21, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr22, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr23, $r4' --asm 'vsle.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vsle.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vsle.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vsle.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vsle.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vsle.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vsle.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vsle.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23'
